'''Gayle Sertim''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who led the civilian security force at a [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] [[Hyperbaride synthesis plant|synthesis]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. After the death of the plant's original [[Managing Director]], [[Arviz Linden]], Sertim suspected the involvement of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The plant's new Imperial managing director, [[Vost Tyne]], noticed Sertim's suspicion and had her killed in [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] accident. Gayle Sertim's younger sisters, [[Marci Sertim|Marci]] and [[Darci Sertim|Darci]], were fed a cover story blaming her [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
